criteria.criterion: Clean deterministic reference run is reproducible
criteria.detail: Two clean executions from one seed produced the same Result-SHA and semantic tree.

criteria.criterion: Four declared infrastructure incidents are injected and linked
criteria.detail: Network blip, gate timeout, worktree collision, and sentinel-loss contracts reached their declared terminals with chronicle links.

criteria.criterion: Historical salvage, lease adoption, and external completion scenarios are replayed
criteria.detail: All three historical scenarios reached bounded declared terminals with their machine assertions passing.

criteria.criterion: Parallel remote tasks execute through gates and reviews
criteria.detail: Twelve-card baseline and worker-loss variants used separate coding, gate, and review worker pools.

criteria.criterion: Structured wall and phase timing with per-run token telemetry
criteria.detail: Every report run has validated wall and phase timing. Token fields are typed unavailable because this infrastructure harness invokes no model or CLI.
The dated offline HTML report was generated only after report-schema validation.
The July scope transfer and AGT-2399 boundary explicitly move model and CLI comparison work out of this infrastructure canary.
Every fault and historical incident record links to a stable chronicle anchor.

criteria.criterion: Horizontal remote post-processing reaches ten or more cards
criteria.detail: 12 and 12 cards were active or post-processing in the two variants.

criteria.criterion: Studio, Task Server, and Runner update independently
criteria.detail: Each component received an independent replacement while active authority was checked.

criteria.criterion: Runner remains autonomous for a real ten-minute Task Server outage
criteria.detail: 600013 ms elapsed with two active slots, 60 useful work units each, and exact-fence replay.

typedTelemetryLimitations.detail: No model or CLI is invoked by the deterministic infrastructure harness, so token counts are not fabricated or compared.
